title: Vibrant Impasto
description: Un style de peinture à l'huile impressionniste moderne caractérisé par des coups de pinceau empâtés épais et des éraflures au couteau à palette. Il utilise un mélange optique de couleurs vibrantes, un éclairage très contrasté et des surfaces de peinture très texturées aux bords déchiquetés.
description_en: A modern impressionist oil painting style characterized by thick, expressive impasto brushwork and palette knife scrapes. Employs vibrant optical color mixing, high-contrast lighting, and highly textured, tactile paint surfaces with ragged, painterly edges.
description_fr: Un style de peinture à l'huile impressionniste moderne caractérisé par des coups de pinceau empâtés épais et des éraflures au couteau à palette. Il utilise un mélange optique de couleurs vibrantes, un éclairage très contrasté et des surfaces de peinture très texturées aux bords déchiquetés.
prompt: Thick impasto oil painting technique characterized by highly expressive, visible palette knife scrapes, heavy paint application, and dynamic wet-on-wet brushstrokes. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. Employ vibrant optical color mixing, utilizing {{primary_color}} to dominate the midtones and establish the core ambient light. Contrast this with vivid {{accent_color}} highlights applied as distinct, unblended dabs, and anchor the composition using deep, cool {{secondary_color}} shadows in the recesses. Lighting is luminous and naturalistic, specifically catching the thick, sculptural ridges of the textured paint to create high-contrast micro-shadows within the stroke topography itself. Contours completely lack explicit linework; forms are defined entirely by ragged, feathered, painterly edges and abrupt, confident shifts in color temperature. The spatial dynamics rely on overlapping, rhythmic sweeps of thick pigment that create a slightly flattened but highly atmospheric depth. The materiality is extremely tactile, simulating glossy, freshly applied oil pigments heavily layered over a coarse, woven canvas surface. Reflections, highlights, and subtle textural details are rendered as thick blobs of pure pigment, establishing a serene, energetically luminous atmosphere.

video.camera: Slow, steady panning or subtle dollying to emphasize the three-dimensional topography of the impasto paint.
video.temporal_texture: The thick paint ridges, brushstroke textures, and canvas weave must remain strictly locked to the surface forms, preventing boiling or swimming textures.
